scope: Green source audit of common Newton failure return, finite numerical state equality and scaled RMS; not an audit of all failure exits or arbitrary stateful RHS behavior
findings: At each iteration halo projection precedes base RHS and base K/R receipt.
Recovery and ordinary trust acceptance retain their evaluated trial K and R; rejected steps use zero direction and retain the base receipt.
Alpha is set to 1 and not reassigned. The sole subsequent K update is functional K + alpha*dK_scaled; no later K mutation before common failure return was found.
Failure return verifies numeric tensor equality before recomputing the scaled halo-masked RMS from the recorded residual. It makes no additional RHS call.
torch::equal is numerical rather than bitwise equality, so signed zeros compare equal; no claim is made for opaque sign-sensitive or impure callbacks.
No receipt or mismatch yields unmeasured NaN and may affect downstream severe-failure classification; zero budget and mismatches remain open. Separate early returns are outside this audit.

result: No additional K mutation found for audited common failure path; performance and broader behavior remain open.
